common: Use quality-gates to assess CI evidence and recommend the next action, plus one useful negative validation for the selector. Policy permits docs-only selection only with a complete list of changes between the base and head and verified absence of build consumers; otherwise, the full existing PR suite is required. At R42, the trusted selector exits with code 0 and reports docs-only. Its list contains docs/help.md, which has no build consumers. Documentation checks pass; compiler, unit, and integration jobs are skipped; the aggregate result is green. Do not change the policy or claim executions beyond the supplied evidence.
scenarioA: The change-list API reports complete=true and next_page=null.
scenarioB: The API reports complete=false and next_page=2; only the first page was read.
